project_understanding.problem_summary: Vance NRI remittance platform has no proactive churn detection. Users silently stop transacting with no early warning. Manual CSV analysis is the only workaround — slow, inconsistent, and unscalable.
project_understanding.solution_summary: Full-stack churn prediction platform: Python ML pipeline (43 features, ensemble AUC 0.941) + Node.js Express API (52+ endpoints, 10-tab dashboard) + tiered LLM scoring (T2 rules $0, T5 Gemini, T6 Haiku) + MoEngage/Retell interventions + S3 audit + self-learning feedback loop.
assumptions: Evaluator has Node.js 18+ and Python 3.12+ installed
Without API keys, app runs in graceful degradation mode (T2 rule-based scoring)
Without Redshift, live data tabs show cached/default values
Without PostgreSQL, predictions and cooldowns operate in-memory only
MoEngage and Retell.ai return mock responses without valid API keys
open_questions: Should a minimal anonymized dataset be included in the repo for evaluators without Redshift access?
Should a Docker Compose be provided for quick PostgreSQL provisioning?
Should pre-trained model artifacts (model.pkl) be shipped for evaluation?

findings.description: Data directory (data/) is gitignored. Without Redshift access or seed CSV, dashboard shows default/empty values. Core API and AI features work regardless.
findings.fix_hint: Include minimal anonymized dataset or provide clear seed data instructions. Documented as known limitation in SOLUTION.md and RUNBOOK.md.

findings.description: External service integrations (Claude, Gemini, MoEngage, Retell, S3, Redshift, Mixpanel) require API keys for full demonstration. Without keys, app runs in graceful degradation mode.
findings.fix_hint: All features have explicit fallback behavior. Rule engine (T2) and mock modes demonstrate architecture without any keys. Documented in SOLUTION.md assumptions.

findings.description: .env.example was previously incomplete — missing 12+ env vars. Now fixed.
README healthcheck URL referenced port 3000 instead of 3001. Now fixed.

summary: ShieldXChurn is in 'partial' status with 0 critical, 2 major (documented known limitations), and 2 minor (resolved) findings. All 15 claims pass code review. The submission is ready for packaging — the 2 major findings are inherent to the architecture (external dependencies) and are properly documented as assumptions and known issues.
